purpose: Main Figure 5 matched fixed-band IK/AD order scan
figure_contract: Panels a/c use csplit=cspread=12.024 at target 1e-4; panels b/d use csplit=cspread=14.471 at target 1e-5. All panels scan P=5--9, vary only M along a curve, include the common under-resolved M=12 diagnostic, and report frames 26--51.
error_definition: Pooled relative RMS on frames 26--51 against the common tight Ewald force dump; uncertainty is the SEM over balanced holdout blocks of sizes 5,5,5,5,6.
